## StrategyMaker type

The `s` a relation's `strategies` receives: `s(loader, { needs, hints, coverage, project })`  makes one strategy, its loader keyed by the relation's `from` and its projection typed.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export type StrategyMaker<E extends Entities, F extends keyof E & string, T extends keyof E & string, L extends Attrs> = <V, LN extends Attrs, CP, LH extends Attrs, const NeedK extends keyof CarriedOf<E, F> & string = never, const HintK extends keyof CarriedOf<E, F> & string = never>(loader: Loader<F, KeyOf<E, F>, V, LN, CP, LH>, spec: {
    readonly needs?: readonly NeedK[];
    readonly hints?: readonly HintK[];
    readonly coverage?: Coverage;
    readonly project: (ref: Ref<KeyOf<E, F>, Pick<CarriedOf<E, F>, NoInfer<NeedK>>, Pick<CarriedOf<E, F>, NoInfer<HintK>>>, value: V) => readonly LinkOut<KeyOf<E, T>, L, CarriedOf<E, T>>[];
}) => Strategy<F, T>;
```
